1.method: Roark: disc simply supported at the bore edge (sigma = 1.25 p a^2/t^2, as fea.py case 7), rectangle simply supported on the BW slot (Table 11.4 case 1a, conservative for an obround); SF on the abraded modulus of rupture; slides: plate radiation on one face, rim at chamber temperature; thermal-shock parameter R = MR(1-nu)/(E alpha)

2.fkm_src: flat elastomer gasket: ASME BPVC VIII-1 Appendix 2 Table 2-5.1 gives y = 200 psi (1.4 MPa), m = 1.00 for elastomer >= 75A; 15-35 % compression is the usual working range for flat FKM vacuum gaskets (assumed); compression modulus 6-12 MPa for a thin, wide 75A strip (shape factor > 3; assumed from Gent's E_c = E(1 + 2kS^2))
2.screw_src: M4 x 0.7: tensile stress area 8.78 mm2 (ISO 898-1); A4-70 stainless proof stress 450 MPa (ISO 3506-1); preload 75 % of proof (Shigley, non-permanent joints); nut factor K 0.2
2.method: clamp ring bottoms on the wall (frame_features): gasket squeeze set by the sheet, the 0.75 mm the seat allows, and the window's thickness tolerance shared by the two gaskets; gasket force = E_c x squeeze x area; screws: preload from torque (K 0.2) vs gasket force + 20 mbar with margin 2; Parker face gland as module_params.FACE_1P78 for the O-ring option

3.method: cantilever plate from the chamber's left wall to the camera's centre of mass, camera as a rigid body (mass and pitch inertia) at the tip: 2-DOF eigenvalues with the plate's consistent mass; image shift = translation + tilt x working distance (mode 1's shape for the vibration); criterion f1 >= 2.5 x 60 Hz and vibration < 0.5 px; the static sag is aimed out when the camera is set up
